rootURL.description: URL users browse to, such as http://git.example.com/; clone URLs and links are built from it

adminUser.description: Administrator account, created on first start; Forgejo reserves some names, such as admin

adminPassword.description: The administrator's password; applied on every start

allowRegistration.description: Let anyone who reaches Forgejo register an account

port.description: Forgejo's HTTP port. When exposed with EXPOSE_VIP, keep it different from the exposed port (80) and set it as target_port

sshPort.description: Port Forgejo's built-in SSH server listens on, behind the exposed SSH port

publicSSHPort.description: SSH port shown in clone URLs: the port exposed on the VIP

settings.description: Extra app.ini settings by section, applied after the block's own, such as {"database": {"DB_TYPE": "mysql"}}
